---
name: Handbook feedback
about: Record a specific decision the guidance helped or made harder
title: ''
---

### What decision were you making?

Name the task and the guide you used or the place where you expected to find it. Use a synthetic example when the work is private.

### What did you understand, and what happened?

Give the interpretation you acted on and the observable result. If a question is still open, say what evidence would settle it.

### What would help next time?

Suggest the smallest edit, link, example or workflow change worth trying. If the guidance worked well, identify the detail worth keeping.
